## Goal
Qualify the largest genuinely supported subset of the exact twelve provisional full-cover observations below. The inherited detector total is 687361.46304426 m² across eight fine families; neither coverage nor detector area is acceptance or delivered repair.

## Acceptance
1. Authenticate original component bytes and complete source/query custody for each processed ID; preserve every original ID and all twelve qualification outcomes.
2. Inspect consumed geoBoundaries GRC ADM3 2010 source (326 features; whole decoded SHA-256 72179d50a8a85aa9fecf996761f905db9e8a59f4eb882f8481f88651692b7e18), its source role/license/vintage and known limitations. Use original source bytes, not a modern replacement.
3. Apply existing strict source-relative physical and current target/neighbor premises at selected baseline 6a99a7606b9c2d11ac8cd093610653d4cd5d1382. Retain every failed or unresolved predicate. No tolerance change, geometry normalization or new numerical repair method.
4. Produce an accepted-source v2 handoff only for actual supported IDs, with exact current target/neighbor and original source evidence suitable for existing method15. A zero-supported result is valid only with all twelve dispositions and precise actionable blockers. Independent exact-head source/geometry review is required before calling the handoff accepted.
5. Preserve separate Greek legal/current-roster work #819, #1002, #1006, #1007, regional packets #71/#420/#421 and completed Dodecanese source packet #1367/#1522. This new source-only observation cohort has no shared owned paths and does not claim completion of those scopes. Dodecanese #1367 uses a distinct eleven-target family; these exact targets are outside it. No production/provider actions.
